Definition
[Normal-coordinate Jacobian] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0239 \group Parametrix

For $r(x)=d(x,y)$ and geodesic spherical coordinates about $y$, define \[ \alpha (x,y):=\frac{\sqrt{\det g^S(x)}}{r(x)^{n-1}}. \] In normal coordinates this is $\sqrt{\det (g_{ij})(x)}$ and extends smoothly to the diagonal with value one.
